purpose: Static proposed roadmap index, not a native Codex schema, task database or execution state. Goal scope is in the linked proposal; after activation its accepted copy is authoritative.

milestones.title: Make both interfaces usable and safely deployable
Operate a controlled private AWS demonstration
Assess the workflow and prepare a private release candidate

goals.title: Adopt the actual initializer and accepted project rules

criteria.text: Record the exact output of git agent --version and verify the reviewed version is exactly 0.2.0 before invoking the current wrapper; reject look-alike/prerelease versions. Run a fresh preview and safe rerun against this worktree root, retaining exit codes and adoption gaps. Link the historical first application separately.

A fresh native agent/editor session identifies the generated instruction entry point, work-goal/worktree-flow skills and two reviewer roles; retain observable discovery output rather than merely listing files.

The human adopts or explicitly rejects each product-command, owner, review, isolation and release-control choice. No required UNCONFIGURED field remains for the first local goal; unresolved hosted controls are recorded as remote-work blockers.

The accepted PLANS guidance points to this roadmap and one canonical active-goal location. No .env, private executable or secret enters tracked files. Record the actual public repository, protected-branch, CI, and human-review controls before claiming remote recovery or release safety.

artifacts.purpose: Initializer invocation, actual output, gap decisions and accepted authority.
Observed native instruction/skill/role discovery, with unavailable checks stated.
Local-only boundary, required external controls and current privacy observation when available.

goals.title: Validate the existing version guard with a red/green challenge

criteria.text: In a disposable worktree, commit a deliberately restored old substring check on a local-only challenge branch and show that the existing mock tests fail for 0.2.01, 10.2.0 and 0.2.0-rc.1. Retain that exact challenge commit, failing assertions and exit status. Archived pre-fix evidence is historical context, not a new goal run or a new product defect.

On the unchanged current source, exact reviewed version 0.2.0 reaches mock init, while incompatible, prefix/suffix look-alikes, empty and malformed outputs are rejected before init is invoked. Also run a preview with the reviewed real initializer on the current worktree; distinguish that observation from mock coverage.

All existing tooling checks remain selected and passing on the intended host, including project-root protection, extra-argument rejection, preservation and forwarding of initializer exit code 3. Record any host-specific skipped check explicitly; do not replace assertions with snapshots.

Obtain independent contract and adversarial reviews of fixed candidate S, including the challenge method and any actual product diff. A relevant source or test change invalidates stale review coverage. Record actual acceptance separately; no reviewer, tag or approval is fabricated.

artifacts.purpose: Actual defect reproduction with the expected failing assertion.
Post-fix regression matrix and retained tooling suite.
Bounded source diff, candidate identity and reviewer dispositions.

goals.title: Recover a goal across two worktrees and a session interruption

criteria.text: Two named worktrees have nonconflicting ports, Compose project names and data volumes; each has one identified writer and progress record based on the same accepted plan revision.

Record at least two included branch commits, one explicit nonincluded alternative or change proposal, and the assembled candidate. An unaccepted scope change must not silently modify success criteria.

Interrupt the authoring session, preserve a checkpoint, and resume in a fresh directory/session using only retained records. Retrieve every indispensable artifact and match its digest before reporting complete recovery.

Deliberately present one stale review and one missing required artifact to the review process. Both remain blockers. Record actual gate observations, handoff duration and unresolved items without pretending this is a statistical model evaluation.

artifacts.purpose: Owners, worktree resources, input revisions and included/excluded branch commits.
Fresh reconstruction steps, digests, timing and remaining local-only state.
Scope-change, stale-review and missing-evidence controls observed in the drill.

goals.title: Resolve and lock the actual Java and UI builds

criteria.text: Maven compiles all backend modules and optional Vaadin module; Angular production build completes. Record the actual JDK/Maven/Node/npm and framework versions rather than assuming candidate pins are compatible.

Review the existing Angular lockfile and resolve the Vaadin frontend lock strategy from actual generated inputs. A second clean dependency installation/build uses retained inputs and succeeds without an unexplained lockfile change.
Existing core, client-state and tooling suites run with actual result/selected-test counts. Skipped application tests during a packaging command are not recorded as acceptance passes.
Document every candidate version correction and dependency decision; retain unresolved vulnerability or compatibility findings with owner and disposition before this goal becomes ready.

artifacts.purpose: Commands, logs, exact versions and observed build outcomes for each module/UI.
Lockfile provenance, clean rebuild and dependency-tree references.
Verified compatibility choices and unresolved findings.

goals.title: Verify persistence against real MongoDB and MySQL

criteria.text: Execute all database integration tests selected at the accepted source revision. Record selected/executed/skipped counts per suite and fail the gate if required suites are empty or skipped; historical foundation counts are not the current expected count.
Prove round-trip preservation of catalog/price/quote versions, exact monetary values, date boundaries and case-sensitive idempotency identifiers in the actual datastores.
Exercise transaction rollback and uniqueness conflicts using separate real connections. No partial hold/order/capacity mutation remains after an expected conflict.
Apply migrations to empty disposable databases and verify the resulting constraints; demonstrate that missing Docker fails the required integration command rather than turning it green.

artifacts.purpose: JUnit/Failsafe raw-report references and nonempty suite counts.
Round-trip, rollback, unique-index and connection-level evidence.
Schema provenance and missing-runtime negative check.

goals.title: Demonstrate the original live event purchase flow

criteria.text: Compose services become healthy and all live HTTP assertions selected at the accepted source revision execute, including role checks, ownership, price-version preservation and competing holds. Record the actual count rather than using the foundation count.
Through the real Vaadin interface publish a product/rate/event, and through Angular obtain a quote and confirm an order. Record the browser steps and corresponding API/order identifiers.
Publish a new price after an earlier quote and prove that the still-valid earlier quote keeps its original total. Retry the same checkout and observe one order and one capacity consumption.
Stop the local stack without deleting volumes; restart and retrieve the confirmed order. Record framework/binding repairs and any remaining demo-only auth limitations.

artifacts.purpose: Executed live HTTP assertions and synthetic request/order IDs.
Actual Vaadin/Angular steps with screenshots/video references.
Volume-preserving restart and current local-only limitations.

goals.title: Add reviewable catalog drafts and publication history

criteria.text: Draft changes are invisible to guest reads until an authorized publication; publication creates one new immutable revision and retains the previous revision.
Two employee writes based on the same revision cannot silently overwrite one another; one receives a documented conflict and no duplicate published revision is created.
History pagination has a stable documented ordering/cursor and deterministic behavior while new revisions arrive; exercise first/last/empty pages and invalid cursors.
Audit records identify authenticated actor, operation, product, old/new revisions and timestamp without storing bearer tokens or full sensitive payloads.

artifacts.purpose: Draft/publish/guest-visibility examples and tests.
Concurrent publication and pagination evidence.
Sanitized representative audit events, with provenance.

goals.title: Preview unpublished prices with the production calculation path

criteria.text: A known fixture produces the independently calculated subtotal, discount and final amount in preview; preview explicitly labels unpublished input/version state.
Publishing exactly the previewed candidate makes a subsequent real quote agree on all monetary lines under identical date/party inputs; quote issuance additionally assigns actual identity/expiry.
Invalid or overlapping effective-date rules and out-of-range party inputs are rejected with actionable messages, not a best-guess price.
No preview mutates price publication, issued quotes, orders or inventory. Concurrent preview/publication keeps candidate identity explicit; previous unexpired quotes remain unchanged.

artifacts.purpose: Hand-calculated input/expected-output fixture set and observed results.
Boundary/overlap validation and employee-facing errors.
Read-only preview and version-isolation evidence.

goals.title: Freeze the price and quote contract with independent examples

criteria.text: A reviewed fixture pack covers no offer, exact threshold, one-below threshold, mixed adult/child quantities and every applicable rounding boundary using expected cents calculated independently of implementation.
Test date-range endpoints, invalid dates, park-local timezone transitions, exact quote-expiry instant and expired/unknown quote errors through the public API.
A quote identifies catalog and pricing versions and cannot be rewritten by new publications. Own/other-user/service-role access behaves consistently across REST and GraphQL.
Publish contract examples and explicit exclusions; retain schema/consumer tests that fail for an incompatible quote or error-shape change.

artifacts.purpose: Independent price inputs and expected outputs.
Actual time/ownership/version and API boundary results.
Documented public request/response/error examples and compatibility tests.

goals.title: Prove capacity and idempotency under real contention

criteria.text: Race at least 100 real hold requests for 10 available seats. Exactly 10 or fewer seats may be held/sold, never more; reconcile final ledger totals and expected rejections.

Replay the same authenticated checkout key concurrently and after an uncertain response. Observe one order, one transition and one capacity consumption; different payload under that key returns a conflict.
Exercise hold-expiry versus checkout, rollback, and an actual process interruption around commit/response. Restart and reconcile confirmed, expired and available counts without manual database edits.
Trace/inspect lock scope and prove dependency fetches complete before the booking database lock. Retain transaction isolation/locking rationale and real SQL evidence.

artifacts.purpose: Workload, request outcomes and reconciled ledger counts.
Kill/restart and expiry/confirmation-race evidence.
Isolation, lock scope, query and constraint analysis.

goals.title: Purchase admission as a separate entitlement type

criteria.text: An admission-only quote confirms an owner-scoped order and one defined entitlement set; repeating the key returns the original result.
Admission checkout never reads or decrements an unrelated event capacity pool. Invalid product/date/version and another owner's quote are rejected before mutation.
Document active/void entitlement states and audit links to order/quote; the future cancellation contract is explicit and old event clients remain compatible.
Migrate existing event-only data in a disposable upgrade fixture and demonstrate both old event and new admission orders can be retrieved correctly.

artifacts.purpose: Synthetic quote/order/entitlement examples and expected counts.
No event-capacity consumption, ownership and upgrade evidence.
Bounded entitlement lifecycle and audit rules.

goals.title: Buy and cancel one bounded admission/event cart

criteria.text: Freeze a reviewed state diagram and expected totals for admission-only, event-only and combined cart cases; versioned price snapshots survive later publication.
Failure to allocate the optional event prevents partial final confirmation of the bounded cart. Confirming retries return one order with the intended admission entitlements and event allocation.
Owner-authorized cancellation voids synthetic admission entitlements and releases event capacity exactly once. Repeated or concurrent cancellation/confirmation follows documented conflict rules.

Separate connections and restart fixtures demonstrate all-or-none booking mutation, no negative capacity, no orphan entitlements and preserved older API compatibility or an explicit reviewed version boundary.

artifacts.purpose: Accepted transitions, independent expected amounts and conflict rules.
Positive, failure, replay and ownership scenarios.
Upgrade, rollback/forward-repair and restart evidence.

goals.title: Finish the Vaadin employee workbench

criteria.text: A recorded browser test drafts a product, previews a price, publishes a revision, configures an event and finds the resulting audit entry.
Demonstrate stale-edit conflict, invalid input, unavailable service and forbidden action with recoverable UI state and no silent data loss.
Core tasks are operable by keyboard with labeled controls and useful focus/error feedback. Record tested viewport sizes and actual accessibility findings.
The UI displays preview/published identities distinctly and does not report success before the backend confirms it; API tests still deny unauthorized writes.

artifacts.purpose: Executed browser flow and recording references.
Conflict, service-failure and permission evidence.
Manual keyboard and automated findings with disposition.

goals.title: Finish the Angular journey and uncertain-checkout recovery

criteria.text: A real browser selects a valid event from server data, purchases the bounded cart and renders the backend's itemized quote and confirmed order.
Drop the checkout response, reload, restore owner/hold/key-bound nonsecret state after authentication and resolve the same outcome; no second order or extra allocation occurs.
Switch user, expire the hold, log out and simulate an unavailable backend. No cross-user recovery or stale-price confirmation occurs, and retry state is cleared/retained according to explicit rules.
Complete the main flow by keyboard and at a narrow viewport; retain automated accessibility findings and manual observations rather than claiming certification.

artifacts.purpose: Actual selection/cart/confirmation path and recording.
Response-loss, reload, identity switch and expiry scenarios.
Keyboard, viewport and accessibility checks.

goals.title: Replace demo tokens with a deployable identity boundary

criteria.text: Validate issuer, audience, signature, expiry and role/subject claims against a real test issuer. Wrong issuer/audience, expired credentials and forged role/owner inputs are denied.
Employee, guest and service-to-service permissions pass a negative access matrix over REST, GraphQL and both UIs, including cross-owner order/quote reads.
Review TLS boundaries, cookies/CSRF/CORS/logout and credential lifetime. Nonlocal deployment refuses demo credentials/profile and prevents management endpoints from public exposure.
Retain a threat model, dependency/security findings and secret scan; no open high-impact blocker is hidden by a successful happy-path login.

artifacts.purpose: Actual issuer/user/service positive and negative checks.
TLS/session/CSRF/CORS and fail-closed configuration.
Trust boundaries, scans, findings and residual risk.

goals.title: Verify cross-service contracts and bounded dependency failures

criteria.text: Consumer/provider tests reject incompatible quote fields, bad identity/date/quantity/amount and error shapes before booking mutation; retain negative fixtures.
Timeout, disconnect, malformed response and dependency 5xx exercises complete within the accepted timeout budget and leave inventory/order state unchanged when confirmation is not committed.

Retry policy identifies retryable/idempotent operations and preserves keys. Large bodies and excessive GraphQL complexity are rejected under reviewed numeric limits without leaking internal exceptions.
Relevant provider changes invalidate dependent consumer evidence; retain a compatibility diff and the exact dependent revisions rerun.

artifacts.purpose: Provider/consumer results and known-invalid payload fixtures.
Injected failure, expected state, observed timing and outcome.
API diffs, dependencies and refreshed evidence coverage.

goals.title: Make requests traceable through the observability stack

criteria.text: Execute one successful purchase and one injected dependency failure; retain real trace IDs spanning the intended service boundaries and matching backend operations.
Dashboard queries display actual request counts, latency distributions, error rates and booking conflicts for a declared time window; exported configuration recreates the view.
An operator identifies the induced bottleneck/failure from retained traces and queries without reading the test script's hidden answer first; record the investigation and uncertainty.
Check telemetry for secrets/high-cardinality owner identifiers and exercise collector unavailability; application correctness does not depend on successful telemetry export.

artifacts.purpose: Real trace IDs, export references and candidate/input identity.
Dashboard JSON/query references and captured workload window.
Operator diagnosis, redaction and collector-failure observations.

goals.title: Measure SQL contention and process-level recovery

criteria.text: Retain EXPLAIN/query-plan output and indexes for a representative operational report and the critical booking path; document examined cardinalities and lock waits.

Run a fixed concurrent workload with declared dataset, machine, client count and duration; retain raw counts/latency/error distributions, including expected sellouts separately from unexpected errors.
Interrupt a local application process and a disposable database at specified points, restore service, and reconcile orders/holds/entitlements/capacity against an independent ledger oracle.
A proposed performance change is compared against the same inputs, with correctness suites rerun. Negative/no-improvement results remain reported rather than selectively discarded.

artifacts.purpose: Queries, indexes, actual plans and lock-wait observations.
Fixed workload inputs and measured results, including failed attempts.
Actual interruption, restoration and invariant reconciliation.

goals.title: Build traceable distributable artifacts from clean source

criteria.text: Build all selected deployable artifacts from clean source S with recorded toolchain/configuration inputs; record image digest D and source relationship, not only a mutable tag.
Generate real dependency/SBOM and vulnerability reports for the produced binaries/images; retain findings and required dispositions under accepted policy.
Rebuild/retrieve in a clean environment and compare the defined reproducibility properties. Explain nondeterministic metadata rather than asserting bit-identical output without measuring it.
Retained artifacts have digest, owner, retrieval steps and expiry/retention commitment; independently retrieve at least one image and one nonimage artifact and verify their identities.

artifacts.purpose: Source S, build inputs, artifact D and reproducibility observations.
Real SBOM/scan paths, verified pins and risk dispositions.
Storage, retention and tested retrieval for all required outputs.

goals.title: Execute the GitHub and Jenkins delivery checks

criteria.text: Execute both pipelines and retain run URLs/IDs, source S, selected test counts and artifact digests. A required missing/failed/skipped suite makes the actual run fail.
Inject a harmless known test failure on a scoped branch and demonstrate that promotion is blocked; retain the failed run as well as the repaired run.

Credentials are least-privilege and untrusted changes cannot access publishing/deployment secrets; record the actual public-repository, protected-branch, workflow-permission and applicable environment-control observations.

Human review for a version-producing merge remains external to agent/model agreement. Pipeline evidence and artifact retrieval are linked from the canonical goal record only after retention is confirmed.

artifacts.purpose: Actual GitHub/Jenkins runs, counts, source and artifacts.
Known failed check and observed promotion denial.
Permissions, trust boundaries, private status and human gates.

goals.title: Roll forward and back on local Kubernetes

criteria.text: Deploy by artifact digest with at least two replicas of one stateless service; readiness/liveness and service routing behave correctly under a restarted replica.
Run the authenticated purchase exercise during a rolling update and report all unexpected errors plus invariant reconciliation; actual deployment health is recorded separately from pipeline success.
Roll back a deliberately bad application candidate or execute the accepted forward-repair path when schema compatibility prevents rollback; retain the actual source/artifact/environment identities.
Recreate the local deployment from retained manifests/configuration/secrets references without copying live credentials into Git; demonstrate cleanup confined to the owned namespace/resources.

artifacts.purpose: Cluster/configuration/artifact identity and replica/probe evidence.
Promotion, failure, health and recovery observations.
Reconstruction inputs and scoped cleanup.

goals.title: Approve a bounded private AWS experiment

criteria.text: Document actual account/region/network/resource inventory and reviewed compatible versions, including the MongoDB hosting choice; dependency access and licensing are explicit.
Record priced assumptions with date, resource limits, maximum authorized spend, stop condition, owner and teardown steps; alerts alone are not represented as a guaranteed hard spending cap.
Specify measurable RPO/RTO and restoration consistency requirements across catalog, pricing and booking; explain backup retention and the consequences of deleting demo data.

The human records a scoped authorization with approved account, region, resource set, exposure and budget before G-0023 is active. Unapproved or insufficient access remains needs-decision/blocked, not a pass.

artifacts.purpose: Resources, topology, database choice, identities and recovery targets.
Dated estimate, limits, stop conditions and teardown inventory.
Actual human decision for scoped cloud operations.

goals.title: Deploy the approved private EKS/Aurora environment

criteria.text: Actual inventory matches the authorized account/region/resource/exposure plan; record private access and absence of unintended public application/database endpoints.
Execute the purchase and transactional checks against Aurora and the approved MongoDB deployment; record differences from local MySQL rather than asserting drop-in equivalence.
Promote one reviewed image change with real probes/multiple replicas and retain cloud metrics, logs and health checks tied to S and D.
Exercise credential delivery/rotation and a cost stop/cleanup procedure on owned resources; preserve evidence without leaking secrets or misrepresenting billing delays.

artifacts.purpose: Authorized-vs-actual resources and network exposure checks.
Aurora/Mongo tests, image rollout and measured health.
Secret rotation, monitoring, cost observation and scoped cleanup exercise.

goals.title: Restore the platform and verify cloud teardown

criteria.text: Restore the selected catalog, price/quote and booking checkpoints into an isolated approved target and reconcile cross-service identities and order/capacity/entitlement totals.
Measure actual data loss/recovery time against accepted G-0022 RPO/RTO; a missed target is a failed criterion or a separately approved changed plan, not silently redefined success.
Rebuild application configuration and artifact identity from retained references without chat history or workstation-local-only state; verify indispensable artifact downloads/digests.
After human-authorized teardown, enumerate remaining compute, database, load balancer, storage, snapshots/logs and identity resources, with intentional retained items and billing follow-up owner.

artifacts.purpose: Observed recovery time/data loss and invariant reconciliation.
Fresh restoration of configuration/artifact references.
Removed/retained resources, cost consequences and follow-up.

goals.title: Investigate commerce failures in Splunk

criteria.text: Ingest real sanitized logs for a fixed purchase/failure workload and record time window, source revision, index/source configuration and actual searchable events.
Execute saved SPL searches for failed checkout, repeated idempotency keys and a service-error trend; compare returned counts/events with the known workload oracle.
An independent operator follows the search runbook and identifies the induced failure using only retained queries/logs, with uncertainty and false positives documented.
Record license/access/retention constraints and verify tokens, sensitive headers and real personal data are absent. Missing access keeps this goal blocked.

artifacts.purpose: Actual ingestion/configuration and access/retention boundary.
Versioned .spl source, real results and workload reconciliation.
Independent investigation steps and observations.

goals.title: Diagnose a Java business transaction in AppDynamics

criteria.text: Verify the selected Java agent/controller combination against the actual JDK/service baseline, then retain a successful connection and detected application transaction.
Generate a declared slow/failing workload and locate the corresponding business transaction with actual timing and downstream diagnostics.
Compare the diagnosed cause with the independent injected-fault oracle and record the investigation, overhead observation and any instrumentation conflicts.
Record licensing/access/credentials/retention decisions and a reversible uninstall/disable procedure; unavailable access remains a visible blocker, not equivalent-tool coverage.

artifacts.purpose: Actual compatibility, controller access and transaction discovery.
Measured business transaction and induced-fault investigation.
Access/retention, reversible installation and residual limitations.

goals.title: Demonstrate graph-data compatibility separately

criteria.text: Seed the same dataset twice without duplicate nodes/relationships and apply documented uniqueness/relationship constraints or validated equivalents.
Queries return the independently specified compatible/incompatible results for direct, transitive, missing-node and conflict cases, with traversal bounded deliberately.
Run real Neo4j tests and retain query text, plan/diagnostics, dataset identity and observed results, not only mocked graph responses.
The graph service can be stopped without affecting existing checkout correctness; explain what GraphQL and graph storage demonstrate separately.

artifacts.purpose: Fictional dataset, constraints and idempotent import evidence.
Executed queries/tests and independent expected result sets.
Isolation from checkout and separate capability explanation.

goals.title: Benchmark the fixed release candidate honestly

criteria.text: Before execution, accept hardware/dataset/warm-up and workload limits. Proposed starting target: 20 concurrent clients for 10 minutes after warm-up; quote p95 <=500 ms, checkout p95 <=1000 ms and unexpected error rate <0.1%. These are proposed project targets, not production SLAs.

Retain raw samples/counts for three runs with identical inputs, including p50/p95/p99, throughput and errors. Expected sellouts/conflicts are reported separately rather than hidden in the error denominator.
After every run independently reconcile orders, entitlements, holds and capacity: zero oversell, duplicate confirmation or cross-owner leakage is mandatory regardless of latency.
Publish all run results, limitations and any target miss. A changed workload/target/hardware requires a new accepted plan revision and new evidence, not relabeling the old result.

artifacts.purpose: Accepted workload, hardware, independent targets and expected outcomes.
Raw dataset references and complete observed distributions/invariant checks.
Reproducibility, limitations and all failed or revised attempts.

goals.title: Evaluate goal-driven development using PR and CI records

criteria.text: Audit at least five materially different executed goals, including the small defect, database/full-stack validation, commerce change, delivery and recovery. Trace every accepted criterion to actual current-candidate evidence.

Run the defined stale-review, missing-evidence, known-defect and interrupted-handoff checks under the adopted policy. All must produce the intended blocked/needs-decision or recoverable outcome; retain negative observations.
Report actual review rounds, blockers found, regressions, reopened goals, lost/unretrievable artifacts, handoff restoration time and costs where observable. Unknown/missing measurements stay unknown.

Document process changes as proposals reviewed under the previous rules; retain a human decision and calibration needs for any model/guide change. Do not allow the candidate to weaken its own acceptance conditions.

artifacts.purpose: Goal-by-goal traceability, measured process outcomes and missing data.
Known-good/bad, stale review, missing artifact and handoff trials.
Human evaluation, limitations and separately governed improvement proposals.

goals.title: Prepare a truthful private release-candidate dossier

criteria.text: From a clean supported machine, follow the retained instructions and reproduce the accepted demonstration using the exact source/artifact versions. Record required private/licensed dependencies separately.

Every portfolio capability claim points to a completed goal and executed evidence; all remaining access, deployment, security and scope limitations remain visible. The full role-complete label requires M0-M9 gates, including Splunk/AppDynamics/Neo4j.
Inspect source/assets, secrets, logs, license/provenance and downloadable artifacts for a potential future public release; retain findings and actual owner decisions without publishing.

Record current independent reviews, human authorization before any version-producing merge, actual merged revision/artifact/tag only if performed, and retrieval/rollback ownership. Public publication remains a separate explicit decision.

artifacts.purpose: Fresh-machine result, runbook and actual demo recording.
Capability-to-evidence map and privacy/license/source audit.
Actual private-candidate review/approval and separate publication decision status.

JDK 21 and Bash; in-memory domain adapters only.
